faqItems.question: What classes are available at Vidya Academy?
faqItems.answer: Vidya Academy lists Play Group and Nursery, LKG and UKG, Classes 1–5, and Classes 6–8. Contact the school to confirm current class availability.

faqItems.question: Where is Vidya Academy located?
faqItems.answer: Vidya Academy is located at 1172/1 Railway Station Road, Moodlakatte, Kundapura, Karnataka – 576217.

faqItems.question: What age groups are covered?
faqItems.answer: The website currently lists Play Group from 1.5–2.5 years, Nursery from 2.5–3.5 years, LKG from 3.5–4.5 years, UKG from 4.5–5.5 years and Class 1 at 6 years. Parents should contact the school to confirm current eligibility and age cut-offs.

faqItems.question: Does Vidya Academy provide transportation?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The school website states that transportation facilities are available to and from the school.

faqItems.question: Does the school have CCTV surveillance?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Vidya Academy states that the campus has 24×7 CCTV surveillance.

faqItems.question: What kind of learning approach does Vidya Academy follow?
faqItems.answer: The school uses a child-centred, play-based and experiential approach that combines structured learning with creative, social, physical and language-development activities.

faqItems.question: Does the school focus on spoken English?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Spoken English, pronunciation and vocabulary are specifically highlighted among the school’s learning facilities.

faqItems.question: What activities are included in the curriculum?
faqItems.answer: Activities include story and library sessions, rhymes and songs, early mathematics, art and craft, play, garden visits, celebrations, Little Chef, dance and field trips.

faqItems.question: Does Vidya Academy focus only on academics?
faqItems.answer: No. The school’s approach covers cognitive, physical, language, social-emotional and self-help development alongside academic foundations.

faqItems.question: Does Vidya Academy have outdoor play facilities?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The school lists an outdoor play area with gardens and sand pits.

faqItems.question: Does Vidya Academy have a library?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The school has a library intended to encourage reading habits from an early age.

faqItems.question: What makes the school’s environment child-friendly?
faqItems.answer: The school highlights child-friendly furniture, colourful classrooms, indoor and outdoor activity areas, smaller batches, green surroundings and a safety-focused campus.

faqItems.question: Does Vidya Academy have an award or recognition?
faqItems.answer: Yes. The school states that it received the Karnataka Shikshana Rathna Award for Best Preschool in January 2025.

faqItems.question: How can I enquire about admission?
faqItems.answer: Parents can contact Vidya Academy at +91 91480 19301 or use the website enquiry form to ask about admissions, classes and campus visits.

Vidya Academy
paragraphs: Every child begins their learning journey differently. At Vidya Academy, we create a warm, child-friendly environment where children feel comfortable asking questions, trying new things, making friends and developing the confidence to learn.

Our approach brings together structured learning, play, creativity, movement, language development and everyday life skills. Children are encouraged to explore their interests while developing the foundations they need for the next stage of education.
Located in the green surroundings of Moodlakatte, Kundapura, Vidya Academy is designed to make the early years meaningful, active and enjoyable.

introduction: Vidya Academy is a child-centred school in Moodlakatte, Kundapura, focused on creating a positive foundation for early learning and primary education. We believe children learn best when they feel safe, valued and encouraged to explore.

Our educational approach combines structured learning with play, creativity, movement, language experiences, social interaction and practical activities. This helps children develop not only academic readiness, but also confidence, independence, communication and positive relationships.

Set in a green and peaceful environment, the school provides children with opportunities to learn both inside and outside the classroom. We work to make the transition from home to school comfortable and build a strong partnership between parents and teachers.
content.vision: Empowering young minds through experiential and joyful early childhood education to nurture confident, compassionate, ethical and responsible citizens.
mission: Provide joyful, experiential and child-centred learning that nurtures curiosity, creativity, critical thinking and a lifelong love for learning.
Create a safe, stimulating and nurturing environment that empowers every child with leadership and essential life skills.
Adopt globally benchmarked practices in early childhood education, integrating innovative pedagogy, technology and best practices to provide an exceptional learning experience.
Nurture compassionate, empathetic and responsible individuals, empowering them to grow into ethical, confident and responsible citizens.
content.philosophy: Our philosophy is rooted in the belief that children have a natural desire to learn. Inspired by child-centred and Montessori-influenced principles, we encourage children to explore their surroundings, learn through experience and progress at an appropriate pace while receiving guidance and encouragement from teachers.
content.partnership: A child’s development is strongest when home and school work together. Vidya Academy values open communication with parents and aims to create a supportive relationship that helps children make a comfortable transition into school life.
content.whyIntroduction: Choosing a school for your child is about more than classrooms and textbooks. It is about finding an environment where your child feels safe, understood, encouraged and excited to learn.
whyItems: Holistic Development – We support cognitive, physical, language, social and emotional growth.
Personal Attention – Smaller batches help teachers understand children and support individual needs.
Learning Through Experience – Children learn through play, exploration, creativity and practical activities.
Communication Skills – Reading, listening, speaking and spoken English activities are part of the learning experience.
Independence – Everyday self-help activities help children become more confident and responsible.
Active Childhood – Indoor and outdoor activities give children opportunities to move, play and develop coordination.
Safe Learning Environment – The campus includes 24×7 CCTV surveillance and child-friendly spaces.
Learning Partnership – Vidya Academy collaborates with Key Education Foundation as a learning partner.
Nature and Creativity – Green surroundings, gardens, art, music and exploration encourage curiosity.
content.happiness: We want children to associate school with curiosity, friendship, discovery and confidence. A happy learning environment gives children the freedom to participate, express themselves, try again and enjoy the process of learning.

title: Leadership and
Educational Foundation
leadership.introduction: Vidya Academy is managed by Moodlakatte Nagarathna Bhujanga Shetty Trust (MNBS Trust), Moodlakatte. The trust was formed in 1995 under the leadership of the late I. M. Jayaram Shetty, with a focus on education and social and cultural development in rural communities. The trust is associated with institutions in the wider IMJ educational group and an advisory group comprising academicians, industrialists and entrepreneurs. The institution honours the educational and community vision of its founder chairman, Shri I. M. Jayaram Shetty.

programmes.title: A Holistic, Play-Based Learning Experience
paragraphs: The Vidya Academy curriculum is designed to make learning active, engaging and meaningful. Children participate in structured activities that support early literacy, numeracy, communication, creativity, social skills, physical development and independence.
The school works with Key Education Foundation as a learning partner to support innovative teaching approaches and opportunities for logical reasoning, problem-solving and solution-building.

Share & Care and Open Sesame give children opportunities to communicate, share ideas, cooperate, build relationships and express themselves. Library Time, Tune-In Time, Fun with Math, Eat & Treat, Art & Craft and Play Time bring stories, rhymes, early mathematics, healthy food, creativity and active exploration into learning.
programmes.imageAlt: Children working together with colourful building blocks

programmes.name: Creative and Experiential Learning
programmes.summary: Children explore ideas through stories, music, art, food and practical activities.
programmes.title: Activities that build curiosity and confidence
paragraphs: Open interaction sessions give children opportunities to talk, listen, build relationships and express themselves. Story sessions and guided reading introduce children to books and language, building listening, vocabulary, early literacy and an interest in books.

Rhymes, songs and listening activities support pronunciation, rhythm and confidence in spoken language. Counting, sorting, board games and abacus-based activities introduce early mathematical thinking in an enjoyable and practical way.

Painting, colouring, sketching and paper craft give children opportunities to express ideas, strengthen fine-motor skills and develop creativity. Play supports observation, exploration, simple problem-solving and physical and cognitive development.
